annotations.scope: Authored browser flows; original files are unchanged and every copy is explicitly reviewed. Not independent usability evidence.

upgrade.source: Exact tested 1.8.0 wheel installed in an isolated environment produced the original persisted draft.
upgrade.scope: One actual LaTeX upgrade; five-format contract migration and stale-input tests are separate authored regressions.

transaction.scope: Actual 1.8 installed-wheel LaTeX transaction recovered by the installed 1.9 candidate.

performance.protocol: Authored local workloads; cold reuse includes cache population. Full and warm checks alternate order. Interpreter startup, UI rendering and models are excluded; OS caches are not flushed. P95 is an empirical nearest rank, not a guarantee. Cached retained bytes are bounded; RSS includes live checks, libraries and allocator retention and has no 64 MiB promise. Existing report fields including positions and coverage agree after excluding only created_at; cross-version comparisons also exclude tool_version.

scope: Authored installed-package workflows, content/config/dependency invalidation and complete-report parity. Exact-commit remote CI and downloaded public artifacts remain separate from local measurements. All runtime files in the original performance archive equal the final wheel; only its bilingual PyPI description and checksum record changed. Not independent usability or arbitrary-project latency guarantees. Approved 2.0 Agent work remains required.
